notes: store writes a root variable into the context; the trailing load observes the write, which is how store's effect is pinned from expression mode (docs/isa.md section 5)
the leaf is always overwritten, whatever it currently holds (docs/isa.md section 5)
a missing interior slot is auto-vivified as a map when the next segment is a string key
a missing interior slot is auto-vivified as a list when the next segment is an integer index
the path traverses a.b, but a already holds a scalar - a put/3 LocationError wrapped in an EvaluationError per docs/isa.md section 5's error table
store pops n + 1 values (the value plus n segments); only one value is on the stack here for n = 1
a location segment that is neither a string nor an integer is a TypeMismatchError, the mirror of bracket_access's key rule (docs/isa.md section 5)
pop discards the stack top and pushes nothing, so the value the compiler emits pop after never becomes the expression's result
an empty stack at pop is insufficient operands, not the expression-mode empty_stack rule - that rule belongs to halt, not to an individual opcode
